acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given strategies have been calculated, when I view the Compare page, then I see a Recharts horizontal bar chart (layout="vertical") with Y-axis = strategy names and X-axis = total interest paid (ZAR).
Bars are sorted by total interest paid (lowest/best at top), making it immediately clear which strategy costs the least.
Each bar displays the ZAR amount at the end of the bar using formatCurrency utility for proper South African formatting.
Top performers (strategies with interest below baseline) use teal gradient coloring, while the baseline strategy bar is rendered in gray.
Savings vs baseline is shown as an annotation (e.g., "Saves R X,XXX") for strategies that outperform baseline.
Component shows skeleton loading state while isCalculating is true from calculation store.
If no strategies are calculated (empty results), show an appropriate empty state message.
Chart is responsive: on mobile (<640px), adapts to smaller viewport with readable labels.
Accessibility: Include a hidden data table alternative for screen readers with the same information.
